During the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], a '''tower''' on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] served as the headquarters of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Parella Jiramma Baco]]. Four [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] also resided in the tower, and were employed by Parella as [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]].
